requirements.description: Configuration-only bearer identities: missing or invalid tokens are refused with 401 before any resource lookup (app/auth/service.py).
requirements.qualifyingAssertion: A protected call without or with an invalid bearer token returns 401 UNAUTHORIZED and no data.

requirements.description: Owner/explicit-reviewer-grant authorization after namespace resolution: foreign 403, unknown or wrong-namespace 404, reviewers read-only, test-admin has no business access.
requirements.qualifyingAssertion: The evaluated identity receives exactly the expected 200/403/404 and no state change.

requirements.description: Intake validation and processing limits (25,000,000 bytes, 50 worksheets, 250,000 nonempty cells, hostile packages) before acceptance (app/workbooks/validation.py).
requirements.qualifyingAssertion: Boundary and hostile workbooks are accepted or rejected with the expected status and code.

requirements.description: Immutable source storage with integrity verification on every read (app/storage/blobs.py, sqlite.py).
requirements.qualifyingAssertion: Downloaded source bytes and hashes equal the uploaded fixture before and after audits/remediation.

requirements.description: Six-rule audit engine, ruleset 2.0.0, with deterministic finding identities (app/audit).
requirements.qualifyingAssertion: Exact independently expected finding tuples are returned and repeat identically.

requirements.description: Durable audit/remediation job queue with two bounded worker slots, a 15 s queue bound and 60/180 s execution bounds (app/jobs/worker.py).
requirements.qualifyingAssertion: Accepted jobs reach a terminal state within their real-time bounds or fail in a controlled way.

requirements.description: Review context projection from the stored audit inventory (operation V).
requirements.qualifyingAssertion: Owner and reviewer review contexts list the expected actions and current values.

requirements.description: All-or-nothing targeted OOXML remediation with independent preservation verification and idempotency keys (app/workbooks/editor.py, preservation.py).
requirements.qualifyingAssertion: Approved edits take effect, everything else is preserved and rejected batches change nothing.

requirements.description: Immutable report snapshots and version/audit history (app/services/reports.py).
requirements.qualifyingAssertion: Report bytes and history records are complete and unchanged on later reads.

requirements.description: Isolated test sessions with namespaced data, administrator cleanup and per-session measured code coverage (app/test_interface, app/measurement).
requirements.qualifyingAssertion: Namespaces are isolated and cleanable, and the session code report is retrievable.

requirements.description: Trusted one-shot isolated fault controls for the seven Phase 5 keys, rejected when malformed and never rearmed.
requirements.qualifyingAssertion: Each armed fault produces its exact failure once with preservation, and invalid controls are rejected.

requirements.description: Persisted full-replacement schedule configuration with newest-committed-version selection (operations 11 and G).
requirements.qualifyingAssertion: Valid configurations persist with the exact nextAuditAt/versionId; invalid ones change nothing.

requirements.description: Scheduler dispatch on the original cadence grid with coalescing, transactional claims and busy-version deferral.
requirements.qualifyingAssertion: Due work dispatches exactly one audit per occurrence on the expected grid and never on a busy version.

requirements.description: Durable per-namespace simulated clock with atomic, idempotent advancement independent of real leases.
requirements.qualifyingAssertion: Clock calls set, reject or replay time exactly and never affect another namespace.

requirements.description: Reminder evaluator: UTC 90/30/7-day thresholds, pre-dispatch eligibility snapshot, no backfill and durable considered keys.
requirements.qualifyingAssertion: Exactly the eligible, not yet considered thresholds produce records with the expected scheduledFor.

requirements.description: Durable in-application notification records (DELIVERED/FAILED), ordered by scheduledFor then creation sequence (operation 12).
requirements.qualifyingAssertion: Notification reads return the exact records in order, including FAILED records.

requirements.description: Owner deletion with a durable reservation, active-work fencing and recoverable cleanup of all retained content (operation 14).
requirements.qualifyingAssertion: After 204 every known URL is 404 and no future work runs; refused or failed deletions change nothing.

requirements.description: Uniform ProjectError envelope with X-Request-ID on every business error path, including new Phase 5 codes.
requirements.qualifyingAssertion: Each refusal carries the exact ProjectError code and a request ID.

requirements.description: Review UI: schedule, notification and delete controls with keyboard operation, labels, focus and the stored-version disclosure (app/ui).
requirements.qualifyingAssertion: Browser/manual accessibility evidence; not exercised by HTTP-only tester runs.

requirements.description: Operational monitoring of queue depth, failed jobs, scheduled-dispatch lag and notification failures with a response procedure.
requirements.qualifyingAssertion: Release evidence; not observable through the hosted interface.

requirements.description: Renewable deployment protection of remote tester sessions across the full suite window, with draining instead of interruption (app/test_interface/activity.py, scripts/deploy_host.py).
requirements.qualifyingAssertion: Deployment/local evidence; not observable through the hosted interface.

requirements.description: Additive metadata migration that preserves earlier sources, audits, reports and tester reports byte for byte.
requirements.qualifyingAssertion: Local integration evidence; not observable through the hosted interface.

requirements.description: Independent tester report profiles: own-team model coverage, cross-team omission, 12-component and 18-criterion catalogs (tester/).
requirements.qualifyingAssertion: The frozen profile and catalogs produce the required report shape.
